_comment: Population anchors for the Hong Kong / Deep Bay avifauna timeline. Each anchor carries a basis: 'documented' means the figure appears in a cited survey or report; 'estimated' means it is an interpolation or an informed guess used only to span a gap, and MUST be replaced before this is shown as fact. The viewer renders estimated segments with a dashed timeline so the distinction survives into the artwork.

species.habitat: Intertidal mudflats, Inner Deep Bay / Mai Po
threats: Loss of Yellow Sea intertidal staging mudflats to reclamation
Invasive Spartina cordgrass choking remaining foraging flats
Illegal trapping and net bycatch on the Myanmar wintering grounds
